cohort: 500 mothers with babies between 7 and 12 months of age in Lagos and Taraba States, Nigeria
finding: Both social factors (education, infant sex) and bio-medical factors (breast milk insufficiency, mother's age, mode of delivery) were significant predictors of exclusive breastfeeding in Nigerian mothers.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a significant predictor of exclusive breastfeeding, with mothers who had a cesarean delivery being less likely to exclusively breastfeed.
